blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri on Tuesday said that some of the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (Tesda) training centers he helped build in Bukidnon are being used as “tambakan ng kambing” (places to keep goats or goat pens) or multi-purpose buildings instead of its intended purpose. Zubiri raised the concern during the Senate committee on finance’s hearing on the 2027 proposed budget of Tesda. “The word is that many of these Tesda training centers are being used by [local government units or] LGUs simply as places to keep goats or goat pens, or they’ve […]...
